fire: Many voters began to doubt the senator's account of the meeting.
The union refused to accept the company's new pay scale.

The players openly disputed the referee's decision after the whistle.
He tried hard to persuade the judge of his innocence.

The players openly kicked the ball away after the whistle.
He tried hard to reach the judge's office before noon.
The scientists refused to move the samples from the old lab.
Villagers were slow to paint the new mayor's office.
